description: Workloads that isolate Rust bytecode VM dispatch and call costs.

workloads.source: (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 5000) (recur (+ i 1) (+ acc (mod i 17))) acc))
(loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 2500) (recur (+ i 1) ((fn [x] (+ x 1)) acc)) acc))
(let [f (fn [x] (+ x 1))] (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 2500) (recur (+ i 1) (f acc)) acc)))
(let [delta 1 f (fn [x] (+ x delta))] (loop [i 0 acc 0] (if (< i 2500) (recur (+ i 1) (f acc)) acc)))
(do (defn count-up [n acc] (if (< n 1) acc (count-up (- n 1) (+ acc 1)))) (count-up 250 0))
